content.value_statement: Vue Router mistakes can cause stale data, bypassed checks, and redirect loops. This skill gives focused patterns for safe guards, route updates, cleanup, and production routing.
actual_capabilities: Explains when beforeEnter guards run and when route parameter changes bypass them.
Shows safe async navigation guard patterns with await, promise returns, errors, and timeouts.
Describes how to avoid infinite redirects in auth and onboarding guard flows.
Compares route lifecycle options for param-driven data refreshes.
Recommends Vue Router production setup with lazy loaded views and route meta fields.
Covers cleanup for simple hash routing event listeners.
limitations: Focuses on Vue Router 4 and Vue 3 application patterns.
Does not generate a complete routing architecture for every application.
Uses illustrative examples that still need project-specific integration.
Does not replace security review of real authentication and authorization code.

use_cases.title: Fix Guard Bypass Bugs
use_cases.description: Review routes where param or query changes may skip expected beforeEnter checks.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Auth Navigation
use_cases.description: Improve auth guards that perform async checks, redirects, and error handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare SPA Routing
use_cases.description: Move from simple hash routing to a maintainable Vue Router production setup.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Route Guard
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Vue Router guard for common mistakes. Focus on redirects, async behavior, and route param changes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Stale Route Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me update a Vue component that keeps stale data when the route param changes. Explain the best pattern to use.

prompt_templates.title: Design Auth Navigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Vue Router auth flow with public routes, protected routes, redirect queries, timeout handling, and loop prevention.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Routing Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Vue Router setup for production readiness. Cover lazy loading, route meta, lifecycle handling, cleanup, and navigation failure cases.

output_examples.input: A route uses beforeEnter to protect user profiles, but users can switch profile ids without another check.
output_examples.output: The skill would explain why beforeEnter does not run for same-route param changes and recommend an in-component update guard.

output_examples.input: An auth guard redirects every unauthenticated user to the login route, including users already going to login.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify the redirect loop risk and suggest excluding public routes or using route meta checks.

output_examples.input: A small prototype uses hashchange routing and starts becoming a production SPA.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare simple routing limits with Vue Router features such as guards, nested routes, and lazy loading.

best_practices: Use in-component update guards or watchers when route params drive displayed data.
Await async navigation checks and return explicit redirect or proceed results.
Use route meta fields and public route sets to prevent redirect loops.
anti_patterns: Relying on beforeEnter for same-route param or query changes.
Starting async auth checks without waiting for their result.
Redirecting to a guarded route without checking whether navigation is already there.

faq.question: What Vue Router version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Vue Router 4 with Vue 3 application patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with authentication guards?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers async checks, redirect targets, public routes, route meta, and loop prevention.

faq.question: Does it cover route parameter updates?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains watchers, onBeforeRouteUpdate, and keyed router views for param-driven data.

faq.question: Can it replace Vue Router documentation?
faq.answer: No. It provides focused best practices and gotchas, but official documentation remains the source of truth.

faq.question: Is this skill useful for small prototypes?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when simple hash routing is acceptable and when Vue Router is a better choice.

faq.question: Does it execute code or modify projects directly?
faq.answer: No. It is documentation guidance that helps an AI assistant review and explain routing patterns.
